reason: Five complete 200-grain Qiu-pairwise trajectories reached the prescribed 120-grain fit endpoint, but the freely optimized exponent remained at its lower bound despite highly linear R_A^2.

physics_cross_check.interpretation: Mean individual-grain kinetics obey the von Neumann relation, but extinction-count noise and correlated residuals make the free ensemble exponent inconsistent.

corrective_action: Increase the intrinsic baseline to 20 independent realizations before distinguishing a physical scaling failure from finite-ensemble estimator bias.
